memory.pickSummary: Select a chapter on the left to read its summary
memory.pickCard: Select a card, or create one
memory.keyStateNote: Key state: a change has to be confirmed by hand
memory.historyHint: You can roll back to any chapter in version history

memory.fillSetting: Fill in this setting card. If it is a rule, say whether it should be pinned into every chapter. Give the edits directly.
memory.fillCharacter: Fill in this character’s role, appearance, personality, catchphrase, and arc. Give the edits directly.

outline.volumeGoalHint: What this volume needs to do
outline.worldInjectNote: World setting. Injected into every chapter.
outline.changedBody: Chapters that are already written are not rewritten automatically. Regenerate them on the Write page if you need to.
outline.volumeNameRequired: The volume name cannot be empty
outline.deleteVolumeMessage: Delete “{title}”? Only a volume with no chapters can be deleted.
outline.deleteChapterMessage: Delete the chapter outline and draft of chapter {number}, “{title}”?

fill.world: Using the title and what is already written, propose a complete world setting. Cover the era, geography, power system, and major factions.
fill.book: Using the title and what is already written, propose a complete overall outline. Cover the main plot, the protagonist’s goal, and where the ending is headed.
fill.volume: Fill in this volume’s name, goal, and outline. Give the edits directly.
fill.chapter: Fill in this chapter’s outline: title, goal, conflict, payoff, end hook, cast, and target length. Give the edits directly.
